classification.difficultyReason: Read plotted coordinates and distinguish the listed rules using the value at x=0 and the change in y per unit x. Separating the three decreasing rules requires checking both features, with the candidate list providing scaffolding.

inlines.text: Match each diagram with the correct rule from the list below.

spec.description: Unit Cartesian grid from x = -8 to 8 and y = -9 to 10, positive arrowheads, isolated red points and no connecting line.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied points visible; matching rule withheld.

answer.worked: The plotted point $(0,3)$ gives $y=3$ when $x=0$. Each increase of 1 in $x$ increases $y$ by 1, so the matching rule is $y=x+3$.

spec.description: Unit Cartesian grid with isolated red points and no connecting line; same axes and tick labels as diagram a.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied points visible; matching rule withheld.

answer.worked: The graph includes $(0,0)$. Each increase of 1 in $x$ decreases $y$ by 2, so the matching rule is $y=-2x$.

spec.description: Unit Cartesian grid with isolated red points and no connecting line; same axes and tick labels as diagram a.

answer.worked: The plotted point $(0,1)$ gives $y=1$ when $x=0$. Each increase of 1 in $x$ decreases $y$ by 2, so the matching rule is $y=-2x+1$.
